answer: Make the scarce unit a settlement kernel: a time-gapped bundle of paid work plus locked stake that cannot be copied when a new key is minted. A newcomer first parks funds in an oasis vault that only unlocks after two independent buyers confirm delivery. Those receipts are then cut into a public crystal of counterparties, hosts, and funding fingerprints. Voting weight vests only on unique crystals; if two kernels share a treasury or relay, they merge and the lock is slashed. Farms can stamp keys, but they cannot multiply a genuine kernel without multiplying unlinked demand and idle capital.
